Nikesh Arora, CEO of American cybersecurity company Palo Alto Networks, has received about $147.3 million through a contract tied to 500,000 company shares held by a trust he is a part of, according to a filing with the US Securities and Exchange Commission, as reported byIsraeli tech news outlet CTech.
